mapper.select: SELECT AREABESTID, AREABESTNAME FROM SB_AREABINFO ORDER BY AREABESTID
SELECT * FROM SB_AREAINFO ORDER BY AREAID
SELECT DISTINCT a.modX,a.modY , (SELECT count(*) FROM sb_signinfo WHERE a.modX = modX AND a.modY = modY) as cnt FROM sb_signinfo as a
SELECT NUM, COMMENT, TYPE AS GROUP_TYPE FROM SB_SIGNACTION ORDER BY NUM

SELECT a.IDX, a.MODX, a.MODY, a.FONT, a.MSGACTION, a.MSGCOLOR, a.MSGSPD, a.MSGDELAY, a.TYPE, a.MSG, a.IMGMSG, a.IMGPATH, a.SAVEIMG, b.COMMENT AS ACTIONNAME, c.COMMENT AS COLORNAME FROM SB_MESSAGELIST AS a LEFT JOIN SB_SIGNACTION AS b ON a.MSGACTION = b.NUM AND b.TYPE = 1 LEFT JOIN SB_SIGNACTION AS c ON a.MSGCOLOR = c.NUM AND c.TYPE = 4 ORDER BY a.ORDERNUM
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM SB_MESSAGE WHERE DIVISION = '0' AND SITEID = #{siteid}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO SB_MESSAGE (AREABESTID, AREAID, SITEID, DIVISION, MSGCOLOR, MSGACTION, ORDERNUM, MSGSPD, MSGDELAY, TYPE, MSG, IMGPATH, MODX, MODY, SUCCESS, USERID, USERIP, TM, SENDDATE, REF_IDX, REF_NAME ) VALUES
( #{areabestid},#{areaid},#{siteid},#{division},#{msgcolor},#{msgaction}, #{ordernum},#{msgspd},#{msgdelay},#{type},#{msg},#{imgpath},#{modx},#{mody}, #{success},#{userid},#{userip},#{tm},NOW(),#{ref_idx},#{sitename} )

INSERT INTO SB_MESSAGELIST (MSGCOLOR, MSGACTION, ORDERNUM, MODX , MODY, MSGSPD, MSGDELAY, TYPE, MSG, IMGMSG, IMGPATH, USERID, TM, DIVISION, ENDDATE, SAVEIMG ) VALUES (#{msgcolor},#{msgaction},#{ordernum},#{modx},#{mody}, #{msgspd},#{msgdelay},#{type},#{msg},#{imgmsg},#{imgpath}, #{userid}, NOW(),#{division},NOW(),#{saveimg})
mapper.select: SELECT a.SITEID, b.AREABESTNAME, c.AREANAME, a.SITENAME, a.MODX, a.MODY, a.SYSTYPE, a.BAUDRATE, a.CONTYPE, a.PORT, a.GATEWAY, a.NETMASK FROM SB_SIGNINFO AS a LEFT JOIN SB_AREABINFO AS b ON a.AREABESTID = b.AREABESTID LEFT JOIN SB_AREAINFO AS c ON a.AREAID = c.AREAID ORDER BY a.AREABESTID, a.AREAID, a.SITEID
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO SB_SIGNINFO (SITEID, AREABESTID, AREAID, SITENAME, SYSTYPE, CONTYPE, PORT, BAUDRATE, GATEWAY, NETMASK, MODX, MODY, URGACTION, URGSPD, URGDELAY, URGHOUR, URGMIN, POINTX, POINTY,
TM, USERID, USERIP ) VALUES ( (SELECT IFNULL( MAX(SITEID) + 1, 201 ) AS max_id FROM SB_SIGNINFO as ALIAS_FOR_SUBQUERY), #{areabestid}, #{areaid}, #{sitename}, #{systype}, #{contype}, #{port}, #{baudrate}, #{gateway}, #{netmask}, #{modx}, #{mody}, #{urgaction}, #{urgspd}, #{urgdelay}, #{urghour}, #{urgmin}, #{pointx}, #{pointy},
NOW(), #{userid}, #{userip} )
